about: Single editorial pass on the whisper.cpp base.en transcript of the first 51.3 seconds of Anne Gaylor, A Second Look At Religion (AndrewFFRF, CC BY-SA 3.0). Not a multi-rater study. Rubric: cut silence slices the segmenter isolated (gaps of at least 400ms); keep spoken words, including a line longer than 7 seconds and ASR substitutions (Gayler, deans, through this rock), because this answer is one argument and a mid-clause trim would drop part of it; no trim, because no restart or repeated clause; no b-roll, because the frame is a locked interview and the words do not call a cutaway. This clip has no jokes.
